**Nexo 1.1** brings **plugins**, starting with **YouTube Music: listen together** in voice channels. Nexo
updates itself: look for the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** update your server **before** your friends update Nexo. With Nexo Server: stop it, run
> `nexo-server update`, start it again. Then an admin turns the plugin on in **Settings → Plugins** (it's
> off by default).

## Listen together

- In a voice channel, click the **music** button (the record in the voice toolbar) or **Play music**.
  Search YouTube Music for songs, albums and playlists, or paste a YouTube Music / YouTube link, then
  **Add to queue** or **Play next**.
- Everyone in the channel hears the same song at the same moment. Anyone there can pause, seek, skip, go
  back and reorder the queue.
- Each person's Nexo plays the song from YouTube itself, in full quality; nothing goes through the voice
  chat. Set your own **music volume**, and the music lowers itself while people talk (you can turn that
  off in **Settings → Audio & video**). Deafen silences it too.
- The sidebar shows what's playing under each voice channel.
- If YouTube won't play a song on your device (region, or a "prove you're not a bot" check), the bar tells
  you and offers **Retry**; it keeps playing for everyone else.

## Install

Already on Nexo? Nothing to do: it updates itself.

On a **test build**? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo. Test
builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
